description: Na₈Mg(NiO₄)₂ crystallizes in the triclinic P1 space group. There are eight inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with three NiO₄ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaO₄ trigonal pyramid, edges with four NaO₅ square pyramids,  an edgeedge with one MgO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.49 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.80 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted NaO₅ square pyramids that share corners with three equivalent NaO₅ square pyramids,  a cornercorner with one MgO₄ tetrahedra, corners with three NiO₄ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaO₄ trigonal pyramid,  an edgeedge with one NaO₅ square pyramid,  an edgeedge with one MgO₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one NiO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with two equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.69 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted NaO₅ square pyramids that share corners with three equivalent NaO₅ square pyramids,  a cornercorner with one MgO₄ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one NiO₄ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaO₄ trigonal pyramid,  an edgeedge with one NaO₅ square pyramid,  an edgeedge with one MgO₄ tetrahedra, edges with two NiO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with two equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.27-2.58 Å. In the fifth Na site, Na is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.70 Å. In the sixth Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted NaO₄ trigonal pyramids that share corners with two NaO₅ square pyramids, corners with four NiO₄ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaO₅ trigonal bipyramid, and  an edgeedge with one MgO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.44 Å. In the seventh Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.24-2.38 Å. In the eighth Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.22-2.46 Å. Mg is bonded to four O atoms to form MgO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two NaO₅ square pyramids, corners with four NiO₄ tetrahedra, edges with two NaO₅ square pyramids,  an edgeedge with one NaO₅ trigonal bipyramid, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₄ trigonal pyramid. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.00-2.09 Å. There are two inequivalent Ni sites. In the first Ni site, Ni is bonded to four O atoms to form NiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two NaO₅ square pyramids, corners with three equivalent MgO₄ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids, corners with two equivalent NaO₄ trigonal pyramids, and edges with two NaO₅ square pyramids. There are a spread of Ni-O bond distances ranging from 1.79-1.96 Å. In the second Ni site, Ni is bonded to four O atoms to form NiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₅ square pyramids,  a cornercorner with one MgO₄ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaO₅ trigonal bipyramid, corners with two equivalent NaO₄ trigonal pyramids,  an edgeedge with one NaO₅ square pyramid, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₅ trigonal bipyramid. There are a spread of Ni-O bond distances ranging from 1.83-1.94 Å. There are eight inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in an octahedral geometry to five Na and one Ni atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to six Na and one Ni atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four Na, one Mg, and one Ni atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to five Na, one Mg, and one Ni atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Na and one Ni atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four Na, one Mg, and one Ni atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five Na and one Ni atom.
